Wired into TallyOverlayService.handleTextEvent: dormancy check then node.refresh()+secure gate BEFORE any node.text read (so no read in secure fields); removed the now-duplicate later refresh. insertCurrentSuggestion re-checks dormancy+secure (node.refresh) before OverlayInserter.insert. isTallyImeActive() reads Settings.Secure.DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD (no permission required; fails open to overlay-active on read error). filterTouchesWhenObscured retained on chip (AC-8 unchanged). Tests: OverlaySecureFieldTest 9 (each variation + ordinary/number/email negatives), OverlayDormancyTest 4 — all green. DEFERRED to TO.6 device gate: the binding §3.3 INSTRUMENTED assertion (no node.text read / no setPrimaryClip with a password field focused) and a /security-review pass (this change touches accessibility + secure-field handling). PRIOR — TO.4 complete. Positioning/insets/occlusion (02 §4.5, AC-5). Added pure OverlayPlacement.compute(fieldTop,fieldBottom,contentTop,contentBottom,chipHeight,margin) → Placement.Show(y,below) | Suppress: prefers above the field, falls to below, else suppresses; both placements require the whole chip to lie within [contentTop, contentBottom] so it never crosses the status bar/notch (top) or the keyboard/nav bar (bottom). OverlayChipWindow.show() now computes placement and dismiss()es on Suppress instead of showing an un-tappable chip; buildWindowParams takes an absolute y. resolveContentBand(): API 30+ reads live WindowInsets via currentWindowMetrics (statusBars|displayCutout top, max(ime,navigationBars) bottom); pre-30 falls back to status_bar_height dimen + displayMetrics.heightPixels (IME inset not observable from an overlay window pre-30 — documented degraded path). FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN is explicitly NOT trusted for insets per §4.5. Tests: OverlayPlacementTest 8 pure-JVM cases (above/below/suppress, status-bar guard, keyboard-occlusion, exact boundary, above-preferred) all green; inset glue validated on-device at TO.6. PRIOR — TO.3 complete. Insertion redesign — explicit §4.8 fallback ladder. OverlayInserter.insert now returns InsertResult{INSERTED (tier1: SET_TEXT+SET_SELECTION+read-back+caret restore), INSERTED_AT_END (tier2: verified but selection-restore rejected), FAILED (tier3: SET_TEXT rejected OR read-back mismatch → field untouched)}. Tier decision extracted to pure resolveResult(setTextOk,readBackMatches,caretRestored) and selection handling to pure normalizeSelection(rawStart,rawEnd,len) (Samsung -1 → append-at-end). TallyOverlayService.insertCurrentSuggestion: on FAILED keeps the chip visible (value stays readable for manual copy per §4.8 tier 3) and only clears on tiers 1/2; focus-moved still clears. AC-3 (no silent corruption): read-back mismatch returns FAILED with no mutation claim — covered by resolveResult test. AC-1 preserved: no clipboard API added; ClipboardInserter-absence test still green. Note on tier-3 affordance: implemented as 'leave chip visible' only — did NOT add user-long-press-to-clipboard copy, because AC-1 is grep+test-verified 'clipboard never touched in any path' and adding ClipboardManager to the module is the kind of change that needs the /security-review gate; flagged for TO.6 polish if desired. Samsung repros (pre-filled span replace, hide/reshow -1 append) covered as JVM logic tests; the real on-device Samsung matrix (duplication / occlusion / clipboard-toast signals, 05 §7.3) is TO.6's Firebase Test Lab gate, not unit-testable here. Tests: :overlay:testDebugUnitTest green, OverlayInserterTest 22 (added 10). PRIOR — TO.2 complete. Composing-text strategy: CommitFilter (commit-vs-composition gate), node.refresh() before every read, and Android 17 getTextChangeTypes() act-on-commit (reflection, degrades to pass-all pre-API-37) were already implemented in the working tree from a prior un-recorded iteration; verified against 02 §4.3. The one open gap was AC-7: the overlay_limitation_commit_only string existed but was never displayed (only a string-id-exists test referenced it). Fixed by adding a TextView (@id/overlay_limitation) to activity_overlay_consent.xml so the commit-only expectation actually ships in the overlay setup/onboarding screen, and added OverlayConsentLimitationTest (Robolectric, sdk 33) that inflates the real layout and asserts the copy renders in the view tree (2 tests, both green) — stronger than the prior id-exists check. Scope note: verification was run on :overlay:testDebugUnitTest only (overlay-isolated change); full-repo build NOT run this turn because M4/M5/TO.1 work is uncommitted past the M3 commit (0f9137c) and milestone gates M4/M5 were skipped — flagged for the human. JAVA_HOME must be set to Android Studio JBR to run gradlew. PRIOR — TO.1 complete: deleted clipboard insertion path and implemented corrected event/focus model. (1) ClipboardInserter.kt deleted — clipboard API is not referenced anywhere in the overlay module; AC-1 verified by a test that confirms the class is absent from the compiled output. (2) ClipboardInserterTest.kt deleted. (3) overlay_accessibility_service.xml updated: typeWindowStateChanged replaced with typeWindowsChanged (fixes over-broad blur on window churn, F2); accessibilityFlags set to flagRetrieveInteractiveWindows|flagReportViewIds (fixes cross-window focus resolution, F5); notificationTimeout changed from 100 to 0 (stops keystroke coalescing). (4) TallyOverlayService.kt rewritten: TYPE_WINDOWS_CHANGED handler is now a no-op comment — window churn no longer clears the chip; blur-on-focus-loss only (null source on TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED, or isEditable=false on a focus event); generation counter (Int) incremented before each evaluator call, checked inside the MathEvaluator onResult lambda so any stale callback is silently dropped; FocusToken also checked at result delivery time; recycle() guarded by Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 33 so API 33+ does not call the deprecated method. (5) FocusToken.kt: data class capturing packageName + windowId + viewIdResourceName from node at event time; no live node reference held across async evaluation. (6) OverlayInserter.kt: clipboard-free insertion via ACTION_SET_TEXT of reconstructed full field text; ACTION_SET_SELECTION to collapse composing region before write; read-back verify after write; no-op on mismatch (correct-or-silent); splice() helper is a pure function. (7) TallyOverlayServiceTest.kt updated: FocusToken equality tests (6 cases), AC-1 class-absence test, Samsung -1 cursor fallback test, TextExtractor delegation tests. (8) OverlayInserterTest.kt added: 12 pure-JVM splice() tests covering insert at middle, replace selection, append at end, empty field, out-of-range clamping, reversed selection, unicode text, deletion, identity. BUILD SUCCESSFUL. All overlay tests green.
